title: Parallax photo plate with a URL letter rise
summary: A black plate on a flat colour field fades a photo up inside an inset mask while the plate shrinks faster than the picture; a bold URL rises letter by letter across it, then the photo window collapses to a corner and the letters sink away.
use_when: A short loop that pairs one hero photo with a web address
Editorial or portfolio sites that want depth without 3D
A closing card where the URL is the only copy
Silent social autoplay that must loop seamlessly

look.type_style: bold geometric grotesk, lowercase, tight tracking, cap height about 9 % H, one line about 62 % W, wider than the plate

sfx.event: URL letters settle in their mask
photo window collapses to the corner

structure.shot: black plate centred on a flat green field; a black-and-white group photo sits in an inset window; a one-line URL across it
structure.camera: plate scale 1.00 -> 0.83 over f0-f30 (about -17 %/s), then near static (drift under 1 %); plate grows back 0.83 -> 1.00 over f95-f110
structure.motion: f0-f9 photo fades up inside the plate; f0-f30 plate shrinks with easings.outExpo while the photo shrinks less and the mask inset widens from ~2 % to ~4 % of the plate (parallax); f18-f35 URL letters rise out of a baseline clip mask, stagger ~1 fr, springs.maskRise (overshoot not measurable); hold f35-f95; f96-f110 photo window collapses toward the bottom-right corner (easings.inExpo) while the plate regrows; f102-f110 letters sink back below the baseline mask, left to right, stagger ~1 fr; f110-f120 empty black plate = loop point

params.brand: any brand.json: bg for the field, fg for the URL, display font
params.content.photo: one photo, landscape about 3:2, cover-cropped into the plate window
params.content.url: web address, one line, up to about 16 characters at 16:9
params.fps: composition fps (default 30); all timing scales with it

notes: Measured from 4 fps sheets and 30 fps strips of t 0-1 s and 3-4 s. Plate width (sheet px of 480 cell): 300, 286, 270, 258, 252, 250 at 0.00/0.27/0.50/0.77/1.00/1.27 s, then 250 to 3.00 s. URL rise f18-f35; exit window collapse f96-f110; letter sink f102-f110. First and last frames match (empty black plate), so it loops. Proposed terms (not in vocabulary): parallax-mask (picture moves at a different rate than its mask frame), mask-sink (letters exit down through their baseline mask). sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured; the reference is silent.
